description.value:
Prerequisites: Able to cast 3rd-level spells

The white mage selects one spell granted by a domain belonging to the god she worships. This spell must be at least 2 levels lower than the highest-level white mage spell she can cast. Once per day, she can cast this spell as a spell-like ability. This talent can be selected more than once. Each time it is selected, she can either gain 2 additional uses of a spell-like ability from this talent or a new domain spell.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
